title: October’s Atmos™ Members Day flight deals unlock six charming winter destinations
summary: Through Oct. 10, Atmos Rewards members can save up to 50% on award travel to Helsinki, Munich, Paris, Sapporo, Seoul and Stavanger, where winter is a way of life.
body_markdown:
Cooler temperatures and shorter days don’t have to mean hunkering down for winter. For a limited time,[Atmos™ Rewards](https://www.alaskaair.com/atmosrewards) members can save up to 50% on award travel to[six Global Getaways](https://www.alaskaair.com/atmosrewards/content/members-day?srsltid=AU7gw4Unn0b09jd9bcSskyg8_gLIVz-LseSE6J0iL_cQ74n4XEzy2d-P) , where winter is a way of life. Whether taking in snow-capped mountain views, exploring historic landmarks with fewer crowds, indulging in regional specialties or experiencing rich culture and local traditions, these limited-time flight deals offer more ways to make lasting memories throughout the season.


Atmos Rewards members must book by Oct. 10 for travel between Jan. 15 and March 8, 2027.
